title: Describing People & Spoken Reactions Practice
description: Luyện nghe, học từ vựng miêu tả tính cách con người và các cụm từ bộc lộ cảm xúc trong văn nói qua đoạn thoại giao tiếp gia đình.
transcript:
H: You know, our Jenny has done ___incredibly___ well, Rob. She’s the first member of our family to study at Harvard. She’s a very ___capable___ and ___ambitious___ young woman.

J: Oh , Dad.

R: No, ___it's true___, Jenny.

H: But what about you, Rob? How do you ___see___ your ___career___? Do you see yourself going into ___management___?

R: Me? No. ___Not really___. I’m ___more of___ a… a writer.

H: Really? What kind of things do you write?

R: Oh, you know, interviews, reviews… ___things like that___… and I’m doing a lot of work for the online magazine…

J: Rob’s a very ___talented___ writer, Dad. He’s very ___creative___.

H: That’s great, but being creative doesn’t always ___pay the bills___.

J: You know, my dad’s a very ___keen___ photographer. He took all of these photos.

H: Oh, Rob won’t be ___interested___ in them.

R: But I am interested. ___I mean___, I like photography. And I think I recognize some of these people.

H: That’s because most of them are of Jenny.

R: But there are some great ___jazz musicians___, too…. That’s Miles Davis… and isn’t that John Coltrane? And that’s Wynton Marsalis.

H: You know about Wynton Marsalis?

R: Know about him? I’ve interviewed him!

H: ___How incredible___! I love that guy. He’s a ___hero___ of mine.

R: Well, he’s a really ___nice___ guy. I spent a whole day with him, ___chatting___ and watching him ___rehearse___.

H: Really? I want to hear all about it.

S: Have a cookie, Rob.

H: ___Go ahead___, son! Sally makes the best cookies in New York!

vocabulary.meaning: Có năng lực, giỏi giang
vocabulary.example: She is a very capable worker who can handle any difficult task.

vocabulary.meaning: Có hoài bão, khát vọng lớn
vocabulary.example: He is very ambitious and always aims for high positions in his career.

vocabulary.meaning: Tài năng, có năng khiếu
vocabulary.example: Rob is a very talented writer.

vocabulary.meaning: Sáng tạo
vocabulary.example: He's very creative in his approach to writing.

vocabulary.meaning: Hăng hái, đam mê
vocabulary.example: My dad's a very keen photographer.

vocabulary.meaning: Thần tượng, người hùng trong lòng ai đó
vocabulary.example: Wynton Marsalis is a hero of mine.

vocabulary.meaning: Tốt bụng, thân thiện, dễ mến
vocabulary.example: He’s a really nice guy.

vocabulary.meaning: Cực kỳ, đến mức khó tin
vocabulary.example: Jenny has done incredibly well at university.

vocabulary.meaning: Phản ứng ngượng ngùng hoặc làm dịu lời khen của bố mẹ
vocabulary.example: Oh, Dad, stop embarrassing me!

vocabulary.meaning: Phản ứng đồng tình, xác nhận điều vừa nói là đúng
vocabulary.example: No, it's true, you really did a great job.

vocabulary.meaning: Phản ứng từ chối khéo, không hoàn toàn đồng ý
vocabulary.example: Are you going into management? - Not really.

vocabulary.meaning: Định hình bản thân khi được hỏi (Tôi nghiêng về... hơn)
vocabulary.example: I'm more of a writer than a manager.

vocabulary.meaning: Trang trải cuộc sống
vocabulary.example: Being creative doesn't always pay the bills.

vocabulary.meaning: Dùng để đính chính, giải thích rõ hơn ý mình
vocabulary.example: I mean, I like photography a lot.

vocabulary.meaning: Lặp lại câu hỏi để thể hiện sự bất ngờ và tự tin khẳng định
vocabulary.example: Know about him? I've interviewed him!

vocabulary.meaning: Thốt lên ngạc nhiên, thán phục (Thật kinh ngạc!)
vocabulary.example: How incredible that you met him!

vocabulary.meaning: Bộc lộ sự yêu thích vô cùng hào hứng với ai đó
vocabulary.example: I love that guy, he's an amazing musician.

vocabulary.meaning: Trò chuyện phiếm thân mật, thoải mái
vocabulary.example: We spent the whole afternoon chatting about jazz.

vocabulary.meaning: Tổng duyệt, tập luyện (âm nhạc/kịch)
vocabulary.example: I spent the day watching him rehearse with his band.

vocabulary.meaning: Lời khuyến khích, mời gọi thân thiện (Cứ tự nhiên đi cháu/con!)
vocabulary.example: Go ahead, son! Help yourself to some cookies.

mcqQuestions.q: When Harry says 'She’s a very capable and ambitious young woman', what does he mean about Jenny?
options: Jenny is quiet and prefers to be alone.
Jenny is talented, skilled, and highly driven to succeed.
Jenny disliking working in management.
Jenny is not as academic as other family members.

mcqQuestions.q: When Rob replies 'Me? No. Not really. I’m more of a… a writer', what is his tone/attitude?
options: Confidently stating that he wants a corporate management position.
Hesitant and humble, defining himself as leaning towards writing instead.
Angry at Harry for questioning his career choices.
Enthusiastic about abandoning writing to pursue photography.

mcqQuestions.q: What is the real meaning behind Harry's statement: 'Being creative doesn’t always pay the bills'?
options: Creative jobs are guaranteed to make a person wealthy.
Creativity is valuable, but it may not always generate enough income for basic living expenses.
Creative professionals never have to worry about monthly expenses.
Writing is the most profitable career path available.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Rob’s reaction 'Know about him? I’ve interviewed him!' express?
options: Confusion because he has no idea who Wynton Marsalis is.
Surprise combined with pride, showing that he not only knows the person but has met and interviewed him.
Annoyance at Harry for bringing up jazz music.
An attempt to interrupt Harry and change the topic immediately.

mcqQuestions.q: What is the main function of Harry's phrase 'Go ahead, son!'?
options: Ordering Rob to leave the room.
Warmly encouraging Rob to feel welcome and take a cookie.
Instructing Rob to resume the interview.
Demanding that Rob get back to work straight away.
